description: This file declares the TunerAdministrator class, a singleton responsible for managing tuners and their notifications within the WPEFramework Broadcast namespace. It includes methods for registering/unregistering observers, announcing and revoking tuner instances, and handling state changes, with a private nested Sink class implementing a callback interface.

classes.name: TunerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing tuner notifications and state within the WPEFramework Broadcast namespace.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an observer to receive tuner notifications and immediately updates it on current tuners.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters an observer from receiving notifications.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Adds a tuner to the managed list and notifies all observers about its activation.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a tuner from the managed list and notifies observers about its deactivation.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles a tuner state change, notifying all observers.
